follow-up time: Up to 28 days (infants transferred before 28 days were excluded)
cohort: 432 preterm infants born at ≤32 weeks' gestation admitted to a level-IV single-center neonatal intensive care unit from 2014 to 2016
finding: While infants born to preeclamptic mothers had lower birth weight and a higher incidence of cesarean delivery, preeclampsia itself was not found to be a significant risk factor for the development or severity of BPD in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Infants born to preeclamptic mothers were delivered by cesarean section more often.
birth_weight: Median birthweight was lower in infants born to preeclamptic mothers (1265g vs. 1388g)
